output.headline: Blackstone has two precedents in the target's own sub-sector, one in the Midwest, and pays the highest median multiple on the priority list (17.1x).
output.differentiator: Its median multiple paid, 17.1x, is the highest among the other buyers on the priority list, so it is the most likely to meet an upper-quartile price. [T:record, V:comps]

acquirer_overview.title: A scaled sponsor with a long, mostly closed record
points: Financial sponsor with 25 deals from 2015 to 2024, 22 closed (88%), active in 10 separate years. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:years_active]
Private Equity segment held $416.4 billion of Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025. [P:1]
Median deal of $342M; 6 of 25 deals sit in the $100M-$400M size band, though 16 of 25 are outside provider services. [T:record, K:size_band]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Own-sub-sector precedents and a size fit, but no open platform
points: Two deals in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; sector relevance is a modest factor in its favour. [T:record, S:sector_rel]
Its sponsor angle is size fit: the target is not smaller than its usual range, a slight factor in its favour. [A:angles, S:not_smaller]
It has no open platform, so this would be a new investment rather than an add-on; provider deals are 9 of 25. [A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Two 2021 Healthcare Services deals, one in the Midwest
points: Peak Medical Management: $342M SPAC Merger, 2021, Midwest, 10.0x EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2021-0407]
Evergreen Care Solutions: $299M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2021, Southwest, 14.6x EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2021-0195]
Adjacent dental deals in 2021: Crest Oral Health ($558M Leveraged Buyout) and North Smile Group ($222M Management Buyout), both at 13.5x. [D:MA-2021-0164, D:MA-2021-0453]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and its history pays above it
points: 70 comparable deals price at 10.7x (25th percentile), 12.8x (median) and 15.3x (75th percentile) EBITDA. [V:comps]
The target's 16.8% margin beats the comparable median of 12.9% and exceeds 87% of comparables, supporting the 75th percentile. [V:comps, X:target]
Its median paid is 17.1x; at the ask its buyout returns 18.7% against a 20% target, on a $128M equity cheque. [T:record, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: Same-exit ceiling is $193M, so the bid works only if it underwrites a platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: No open platform, thin provider focus
risk_flags.concern: No open platform in the sub-sector, and 16 of 25 deals are outside provider services. [A:angles, T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: Two own-sub-sector deals and 7 adjacent provider deals show real provider experience. [T:record]
risk_flags.reality: Provider deals are 9 of 25, so the buyer would be building a position rather than adding to one. [A:angles]

risk_flags.title: Midwest footprint
risk_flags.concern: Prior purchases in this or a neighbouring region are a slight signal against the buyer. [S:geo_fit]
risk_flags.mitigant: It bought Peak Medical Management in the Midwest, in the target's own sub-sector. [D:MA-2021-0407]
risk_flags.reality: Only 2 of its 25 deals were in the Midwest. [T:record]

conviction.rationale: Two own-sub-sector deals and 7 adjacent provider deals support the case; the absence of an open platform in the sub-sector is neutral, which keeps conviction at Medium. [C:conviction]
